review: Best rub I have used in years. Put it on a pork shoulder over the weekend and the bark was perfect. Good balance of sweet and pepper, not too salty. Will be ordering the brisket rub next.
This BBQ sauce is the real deal. Thick, smoky, and not overly sweet like the store stuff. Bought two bottles and already low on the first. Shipped fast and packed well so nothing broke.
Good brisket rub with a nice little kick. Knocked off one star only because my jar was filled a touch light, but the seller was quick to make it right. Flavor is excellent on beef.
This map print is a showstopper. The detail on the old rail lines is incredible and the paper quality is heavy and nice. Framed it for my office and everyone asks about it. Worth every penny.
Love this mustard sauce. Tangy and just sweet enough, perfect on pulled pork. Bought it for my dad for his birthday and he has already asked me to order more. Great communication from the seller too.
Beautiful Cumberland Gap map print with great detail. Arrived rolled and in good shape. One small corner had a tiny crease from shipping but it framed up fine. Looks great in our den.
This bourbon glaze is fantastic on ribs. Brushed it on the last few minutes and it set up into a nice sticky finish. Just the right amount of sweet. Will be a regular order for me.

The rub trio gift set was perfect for my brother who just got a smoker. Nice presentation in the box and all three rubs are great. He has already gone through the hickory one. Highly recommend as a gift.
Great little wood sign. The finish on the reclaimed pine is nice and rustic and it came ready to hang. Looks perfect in my workshop. You can tell it was made with care.

The framed map arrived with a crack in the glass. The seller was responsive and offered a replacement right away, which I appreciate, but I was disappointed the original was not packed with more padding. The print itself is lovely so I am hopeful the replacement arrives safe.

Came back for the chicken rub after the brisket rub and it did not disappoint. Crisped up the skin on a whole smoked chicken beautifully and the flavor was spot on. Second order from this shop and another winner.
As an East Tennessee native I love this TVA watershed map. The print is sharp and the paper feels great. Brings back a lot of memories of the lakes and dams. Looks perfect above my desk.
This all purpose rub has become my go to. Good on chicken, pork, even roasted vegetables. Not too salty and the bag size is generous. Shipped quick out of Tennessee and arrived in two days.
Bought two bottles of the Smoky Mountain sauce and we are hooked. Great smoke flavor without being too sweet. Already planning to order the mustard sauce next. Fast shipping and well packed.
The Knoxville 1900 rail yard map is a beautiful piece. I grew up near the old yards and the detail is spot on. Heavy paper and sharp printing. Already framed it for the office.
The habanero peach sauce has a nice fruity heat that builds slow. Great on wings. Knocked off a star only because I wish it had a touch more peach up front, but I would buy again.
Came back for the bourbon glaze after the rub and it is excellent. Sets up sticky and sweet on ribs and chicken alike. Second order from this shop and another winner. Quick to ship.
Ordered the hickory rub on a friend's recommendation and it lived up to the hype. Perfect bark on a pork butt and a great smoky aroma. Will be a repeat customer for sure.
The large 24x36 Great Valley corridor print is stunning on the wall. Rich detail and the colors are muted just right for a historical map. Arrived rolled in a sturdy tube with no damage.

Ordered the rub trio gift set for a buddy who just built a smoker. Presentation was sharp and all three rubs smell incredible. He texted me a pic of his first brisket already. Will order again for Christmas.
This mustard sauce has the right Carolina tang. Put it on pulled pork sandwiches at a cookout and folks kept asking where I got it. Shipped quick out of Knoxville and well packed. Repeat buyer here.
